reasons.refund_claim_supported: Carrier shows delivery but the signature is unmatched and GPS sits 140 m off, so evidence only weakly supports non-receipt amid conflicting signals.
reasons.claim_handling: At 640 USD the claim exceeds the 500 USD cap, so a carrier trace is mandatory first and an open, reversible investigation best fits the evidence gap.
reasons.fraud_risk: Two prior uninvestigated refunds and an unverified camera story add doubt, but repeat claims alone cannot prove fraud, keeping the balance near genuine-with-doubts.
